memories.content: The geography department has proposed a coastal field trip, which has run without incident for four years. This year, there is a new coach operator and a risk-assessment form that needs an extra signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. The department wants the principal's sign-off before the half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters.
